title: Sunflower Punk Girl Poses
description: Four side-by-side panels show the same anime-style female character in slightly different walking and posing stances against a solid green background. She has spiky black hair with a yellow sunflower headband, wears a yellow and black gothic lolita outfit with corset, frilled skirt, and heavy boots, and holds sunflowers and a black whip.
prompt: Anime style character sheet showing four sequential walking and posing views of a confident punk girl with spiky black hair, yellow sunflower accessories, and a yellow and black gothic lolita dress with corset and frills. She wears heavy yellow boots, black stockings with circular patterns, fingerless gloves, and carries sunflowers and a black whip.
